notes.title: v1.1.0
notes.content:
We're excited to announce the latest update to Rune, bringing significant improvements to stability, performance, and user experience.

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list]
[*] Introduced lyrics display functionality
[*] Added support for multiple scrobbling services including Last.fm, MusicBrainz, and Libre.fm
[*] Added Nise Japanese language localization
[*] Enhanced file handling with drag-and-drop support and keyboard shortcut (Ctrl+O) for opening external files
[/list]

[h1]Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] Improved randomization algorithm for the cover art wall display
[*] Enhanced image rendering quality with high-quality filter settings
[*] Optimized analysis performance for better overall responsiveness
[*] Traditional Chinese language option has been promoted from experimental status to stable
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed playback mode switching issues when insufficient modes were enabled
[*] Resolved navigation back text clickability problems
[*] Fixed metadata display issues for blank cover art on the lyrics page
[*] Corrected window dragging behavior that was triggering unwanted navigation actions
[*] Fixed tray icon functionality in Flatpak installations
[*] Resolved navigation bar issues that were causing program crashes due to multiple event triggers
[*] 
[/list]
[h1]Technical Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Removed GPU FFT implementation due to stability concerns
[/list]

We're constantly working to improve Rune and appreciate your continued support and feedback. Thank you for using Rune Music Player!
